description: Sturgian long blue wool coat over a cream linen embroidered shirt, with pale geometric woven borders at neckline, opening, cuffs and hem and fur collar, cuffs and hem. Paired round metal brooches joined by a cord fasten the upper coat. A blue patterned sash with fringed hanging ends secures the waist. Dark trousers and tall wrapped brown leather boots complete the outfit.
